name: one-to-one
description: A manager 1:1 (English) with near-miss points: words that appear without the topic. Written for #101/#136; synthetic.

lines.speaker: Sam
lines.text: Hey, how was the long weekend?

lines.speaker: Priya
lines.text: Good, we went hiking, the weather was perfect. You?

lines.speaker: Sam
lines.text: Pretty quiet. Okay, I have a few things on my list today.

lines.speaker: Sam
lines.text: First, the promotion case. I submitted your packet to the committee on Thursday, and they meet on the twentieth.

lines.speaker: Priya
lines.text: Thanks. Is there anything else they'll want from me, like a self review?

lines.speaker: Sam
lines.text: No, the self review you wrote last month is in there. I'll let you know as soon as I hear.

lines.speaker: Priya
lines.text: Great. Can we talk about the on-call rotation? I've been paged four nights in a row and it's getting rough.

lines.speaker: Sam
lines.text: Yeah, that's not okay. Let's move you off the rotation for two weeks and I'll ask Diego to cover.

lines.speaker: Sam
lines.text: The budget meeting is right after this, so I need to keep this short today.

lines.speaker: Priya
lines.text: Sure. One quick thing, I'd like to go to the Kotlin conference in May, it's in Copenhagen.

lines.speaker: Sam
lines.text: Send me the cost estimate with flights and the hotel and I'll approve it from the training budget.

lines.speaker: Sam
lines.text: Last thing, how are you feeling about the migration project? Any blockers?

lines.speaker: Priya
lines.text: Mostly fine. The blocker is that we still don't have access to the new database cluster, I've asked infra twice.

lines.speaker: Sam
lines.text: I'll escalate that with their manager today.

lines.speaker: Priya
lines.text: Thanks. Oh and I'll be out on Friday for a dentist appointment.

lines.speaker: Sam
lines.text: No problem, just put it in the calendar.

points.text: Switching Priya to a different team
